prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A clean three-column asset sheet on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly three separate large handmade torn-paper rectangles, one centered in each equal column, with generous charcoal space between them and no overlap. Reading order: warm cream watercolor paper, pale sky-blue watercolor paper, soft blush-pink watercolor paper. Each rectangle is front-facing, nearly square, with visible paper grain, softly irregular deckled edges, and a small physical paper shadow contained within its own cell. No borders, labels, letters, grid lines, props, hands, or extra objects.
